Name: Regular Horse
Owner: Anyone in city or close proximity
Origin: Common throughout Axria; especially widespread on the temperate roads and farms around Jazierchat.
Movement: Gallop
Trait: None special
Weakness: None special

Name: Warhorse
Origin: Bred in Jazierchat and other fortified cities from heavy horse lines for guards, hunters, and cavalry.
Movement: Gallop, charge
Trait: Trained not to panic in battle; can carry an armored rider
Weakness: Expensive; requires training and considerable food

Name: Pony
Origin: Common in smaller settlements and mountain foothills, especially around Skalodom and Vyskyna.
Movement: Gallop, rough trails
Trait: Hardy, inexpensive, excellent footing, easy to maintain
Weakness: Low carrying capacity and slower than a horse

Name: Mule
Origin: Common caravan hybrid on the mountain and mining routes linking Skalodom, Vyskyna, and Zaskyna.
Movement: Rough trails, mountain paths
Trait: Excellent endurance, strong carrying capacity, reliable footing
Weakness: Stubborn; poor acceleration and unsuitable for serious combat

Name: Donkey
Origin: Common work animal in Axrian farms and trade towns, particularly around Pieskostan and Severana.
Movement: Rough trails
Trait: Cheap, hardy, low food requirements, good pack animal
Weakness: Slow and limited carrying speed

Name: Camel
Origin: Bred along the desert trade routes of Pieskostan and Severana, where water economy matters more than speed.
Movement: Sand travel
Trait: Exceptional heat tolerance, long periods without water, excellent desert endurance
Weakness: Performs poorly in cold, wet, or steep terrain

Name: Dromedary War Camel
Origin: Purpose-bred military line from Pieskostan and Severana, used along desert walls and caravan approaches.
Movement: Sand travel, charge
Trait: Heat resistance, intimidation against unfamiliar animals, carries heavy rider and equipment
Weakness: Temperamental; poor in cold and slippery terrain

Name: Riding Elk
Origin: Domesticated in the forests between Lesohaj and Juhiera, where dense woodland favors agile mounts over horses.
Movement: Forest stride, high jump
Trait: Moves through brush better than horses, good hearing, strong seasonal endurance
Weakness: Nervous around fire and loud combat; antlers complicate dense terrain

Name: Reindeer
Origin: Cold-adapted herds from the approaches to Chladohrad and its sub-zero wilderness.
Movement: Snow travel
Trait: Excellent cold tolerance, good footing on snow, modest food needs
Weakness: Poor heat tolerance and less powerful than a horse

Name: Giant Goat
Origin: Bred around Skalodom, Vyskyna, and Zaskyna for steep mining paths and cliff settlements.
Movement: Climb, cliff-step
Trait: Exceptional balance, climbs terrain almost unusable by horses, hardy
Weakness: Slow on open roads; limited carrying capacity

Name: Yak
Origin: High-mountain pack breed used on the cold routes toward Chladohrad and the Vyskyna tunnel country.
Movement: Snow travel, mountain paths
Trait: Huge carrying capacity, cold resistant, extremely hardy
Weakness: Slow; suffers badly in hot climates

Name: Ox
Origin: Common agricultural draft animal around Jazierchat and the southern farming islands of Sostrov.
Movement: Heavy pull
Trait: Tremendous pulling strength, cheap to maintain, dependable
Weakness: Very slow and poor for pursuit or emergency travel

Name: Great Boar
Origin: Forest-clan mount from Lesohaj and Juhiera woodland, where boars handle brush better than horses.
Movement: Charge, brush movement
Trait: Aggressive, strong, difficult to frighten, excellent through undergrowth
Weakness: Difficult temperament; less endurance than horses

Name: Wulf
Origin: Large wolf breed kept by frontier hunters in the mountain forests around Dolinoraj and the northern roads.
Movement: Sprint, leap, forest movement
Trait: Excellent senses, aggressive defense, tracking, good rough-terrain mobility
Weakness: Lower carrying capacity than a horse; requires much more meat

Name: Great Hound
Origin: Purpose-bred by Axrian hunters; strong lines are common around Jazierchat’s academy roads and Juhiera’s hunting forests.
Movement: Sprint, leap
Trait: Excellent tracking, loyal, agile in forests and settlements
Weakness: Cannot comfortably carry large or heavily armored riders

Name: Riding Rhino
Origin: Warm-country cavalry beast from the savanna edge south of Pieskostan, later adopted by heavy hunters.
Movement: Charge, rough-ground push
Trait: Enormous strength, natural armor, devastating charge, exceptional carrying capacity
Weakness: Slow, difficult to turn, eats enormously, poor on narrow paths

Name: Elephant
Origin: Native to the warm southern forests and savanna approaches around Stromoraj and Pieskostan.
Movement: Heavy terrain crossing
Trait: Massive carrying capacity, very intelligent, can transport several people or large loads
Weakness: Huge food requirements, expensive, difficult in mountains and narrow streets

Name: Giant Lizard
Origin: Commonly bred around Severana’s desert mines and the rocky cave country of the eastern desert.
Movement: Climb, rock crawl
Trait: Excellent on stone, tolerates heat, can traverse terrain unsuitable for hooves
Weakness: Cold-sensitive; comparatively slow over good roads

Name: Marsh Lizard
Origin: Sostrov wetland breed adapted to shallow channels, mud, and island crossings.
Movement: Swim, mud crawl
Trait: Excellent swamp mobility, strong swimmer, comfortable in deep mud
Weakness: Slow on roads and vulnerable to cold

Name: Water Buffalo
Origin: Raised on Sostrov’s southern agricultural islands and other low wet farmlands.
Movement: Mud travel, shallow swim
Trait: Very strong, stable in mud and water, good pack capacity
Weakness: Slow and stubborn; poor mountain mobility

Name: Great Runner Bird
Origin: Open-ground riding bird from the savanna and semi-desert approaches around Pieskostan.
Movement: Fast run
Trait: Very fast sustained travel on open ground, low burden on soft terrain
Weakness: Poor carrying capacity, easily injured in rough rocky terrain

Name: Giant Tortoise
Origin: Warm-island beast most often associated with the outer Sostrov islands and southern coastal trade.
Movement: Difficult-terrain crawl
Trait: Enormous carrying capacity, very low food urgency, naturally armored
Weakness: Extremely slow; useless for pursuits

Name: Moose
Origin: Cold-forest mount from the wooded approaches south of Chladohrad and other northern wetlands.
Movement: Forest travel, shallow swim, snow stride
Trait: Very large, strong swimmer, crosses snow and wetlands surprisingly well
Weakness: Temperamental, awkward in settlements, unsuitable for disciplined cavalry

Name: Tinky
Origin: Rare divine Axrion beast associated with mountain shrines and earth-forge traditions; regarded as a sacred bloodline rather than a normal domestic breed.
Movement: Glide downward, hover briefly, rough terrain charge
Trait: Massive carrying strength, high endurance, resistant to forced movement, divine presence, armored horn charge. His saliva can can heal minor injuries.
Weakness: extremely strong, but too heavy for true upward flight.

Name: Irok
Origin: Jazierchat hunter-road breed developed from armored courser lines for firearm-era monster hunters; valued for steadiness under gunfire rather than spectacle.
Movement: Strong ground travel, rough roads, stable firing stance
Trait: Cannot fly, extremely reliable, fearless under gunfire, saddle storage, armored hide, steady shooting platform, ignores fall damage
Weakness: reliable and armored, but no flight and not flashy.

Name: Kravex
Origin: Native to Lesy Života; a canopy predator-mount whose Axrian descendants are normally handled only by experienced Tamers.
Movement: Flight, leap, climb, dive attack
Trait: Very mobile, predatory reflexes, claw attacks, aerial pounce, fast repositioning, aggressive temperament
Weakness: incredibly mobile, but impatient and hard to control.

Name: Auralis
Origin: Storm-born stock from Element, brought to Axria through one of the stable interplanetary crossings and acclimated by Tamers.
Movement: Runs through air, cloud-step, storm glide
Trait: Lightning resistance, weather sense, storm aura, can assist rain/wind magic, graceful and intelligent
Weakness: powerful in storms, but less comfortable in dry dead-magic areas.

Name: Veylourienne Prismaticia Mirrorgleam Indigo Peacock Feathered „Veyl“
Origin: Native to Lesy Života, whose overflowing magical ecosystems produce unusually vivid hybrid beasts; Axrian specimens are rare and highly prized.
Movement: Blink, glide, leap, difficult terrain bypass
Trait: Short-range teleport blink, glamour afterimages, illusion shimmer, excellent scouting, stylish distraction
Weakness: can blink, but repeated blinking tires her and may misplace loose gear.

Name: Braksa
Origin: A predator lineage from Ruiny Temnoty, descended from bristlecats brought through dangerous planar crossings near old battle sites.
Movement: Sprint, leap, climb, shallow swim
Trait: Blood-scent tracking, rage burst, savage pounce, fear-resistant, becomes more dangerous when wounded
Weakness: Hard to calm after blood is spilled; can escalate already unstable situations

Name: Veyun
Origin: Rare Sostrov wetland kirin line adapted to shallow water, bridges, and quiet travel between the islands.
Movement: Sure-footed movement, light climbing, water-step, silent gait
Trait: Calming aura, fear resistance, exceptional balance, stabilizes rider’s breathing and focus, serene monk-like presence
Weakness: Does not like reckless aggression; avoids needless violence

Name: Murmura
Origin: Native to the forests between Juhiera and Lesohaj; prized by performers and Tamers for mimicry, emotional sensing, and calm temperament.
Movement: Fast ground travel, graceful leaps, short mist-step
Trait: Voice mimicry, emotional sensing, calming presence, illusion shimmer, can repeat overheard phrases
Weakness: Sometimes repeats things it heard at the worst possible moment

Name: Suture
Origin: Protector walker built in Pieskostan using Granulian motion components; designed as a mobile shield, repair rig, and casualty carrier.
Movement: Heavy terrain crossing, climbing anchors, stabilizer legs
Trait: Fully mechanical, emergency medical rig, shield plates, tool storage, repair arms, wounded transport platform
Weakness: Loud, heavy, maintenance-hungry, and impossible to hide

Name: Index
Origin: Juhieran scholar-bred griff line associated with the coastal cliffs and hunter archives; selected for memory, patience, and monster-sign recognition.
Movement: Silent flight, glide, perch, careful landing
Trait: Excellent memory, monster-scent recognition, night vision, detects old tracks, protects books and scrolls
Weakness: Refuses chaotic riders and dislikes unnecessary risk

Name: Aelaris
Origin: Lesohaj forest breed traditionally trained for silent travel among living tree defenses and moonlit woodland paths.
Movement: Flight, glide, hover, silent woodland ascent
Trait: Essence-buffering calm, elegant aerial maneuvering, high discipline, near-silent movement, resists panic and magical overload
Weakness: Refuses to carry more then one rider.

Name: Karruk
Origin: Granulian heavy boar line kept on the rocky industrial outskirts, where rail noise, workshop blasts, and broken ground make ordinary mounts skittish.
Movement: Charge, climb rocky slopes, smash through obstacles, river fording
Trait: Massive impact force, fearless, excellent against large enemies, thick hide, battle roar, can hold a line beside Morga
Weakness: Likes to strat figh on his own, eats smaller creatures.

Name: Vespera
Origin: Jazierchat noble-estate breed; mirrorsteeds descend from ceremonial cavalry lines selected for glamour, poise, and intimidating display.
Movement: Glide, high leap, rapid turn, elegant sprint
Trait: Glamour shimmer, dazzling display, intimidating beauty, attention-drawing presence, difficult to ignore or target cleanly
Weakness: Refuses to be even touched by cretures with low Charisma. Is very selective of his food and stable conditions.

Name: Goliwheel Mk III “Orbit”
Origin: Granulian Mk III gnomish mobility chassis built around local motion engineering, with design principles influenced by studies of Apparatus.
Movement: High-speed rolling, stabilizer mode, booster jump, suit-docking
Trait: Fully mechanical, docks to Mechanický Goliat, travel acceleration, impact stabilization, storage, emergency deployment platform
Weakness: Speed without armor is higher but steering is harder. Has to recharge on short rest, ot is much slower.

Name: Lumiel
Origin: Elysian celestial species; exceptionally rare in Axria and more often associated with divine or soul-linked planar events than ordinary trade.
Movement: Flight, hover, radiant glide, silent landing
Trait: Celestial aura, language resonance, radiant warding, heightened perception, calm mind-field, ideal for a scholar and interpreter
Weakness: Has trouble to adjust to chaotic locations.

Name: Noxveil
Origin: Hades-touched Axrian courser line found near old planar scars and occult sites; considered corrupted Axrian stock rather than a true Hades-native riding breed.
Movement: Shadow-step, silent ground travel, short wall-climb, darkness glide
Trait: Moves almost soundlessly, resists necrotic and fire effects, can blur into smoke, senses fiendish presence, carries Mishel through dim light without disturbing it
Weakness: Weak in direct holy/radiant zones; becomes harder to command when demonic energy is nearby

Name: Vargast
Origin: Native to Tmavohmla and bred for its black fog, narrow lamp-lit streets, and hostile interior wilderness.
Movement: Sprint, alley-leap, wall-bounce, fog-running
Trait: Excellent urban pursuit mount, sees through fog and darkness, tracks blood and fear, silent pounce, terrifying to monsters that rely on ambush
Weakness: Uncomfortable in open bright terrain; prefers stalking routes over direct travel

Name: Puckthorn
Origin: Native to Lesy Života; trickharts are among its highly magical forest fauna and are notorious for treating training as a game.
Movement: Forest sprint, high leap, branch-step, short illusion-step
Trait: Creates distracting fey afterimages, understands traps and games, can lure enemies into bad positions, nimble in forests, resistant to charm
Weakness: Prankish and disobedient if bored; may “improve” simple plans with jokes

Name: Stormfin
Origin: Native to the wetland and reef ecosystems of Lesy Života; Axrian specimens are especially valued around Sostrov and Juhiera.
Movement: Air-swim, water-swim, glide, hover, smooth descent
Trait: Can carry allies over terrain, lightning resistance, creates static shield-wake, excellent water rescue, calming to Purrtrick because it is almost fish-like
Weakness: Poor in cramped indoor spaces; needs moisture or storm charge to perform at full strength

Name: Silkstride
Origin: Stromoraj canopy species domesticated for vertical travel, branch settlements, web-line hauling, and silent scouting.
Movement: Wall-climb, ceiling-crawl, silent stepping, web-line descent
Trait: Perfect stealth scout, can anchor silk lines, senses vibrations through stone and wood, carries tools and maps safely, excellent for rooftop observation
Weakness: Fragile compared to war mounts; avoids loud open combat and fire-heavy environments

Name: Brundra
Origin: Chladohrad war-mount line bred from cold-adapted northern fauna for snow, icy rivers, and heavy hunting loads.
Movement: Snow-run, rough terrain charge, shallow river crossing, cliff-step
Trait: Enormous carrying strength, cold resistance, rage-resonance with rider, brutal antler charge, can carry oversized weapons and heavy trophies
Weakness: Not subtle; slow to turn once charging; becomes harder to redirect when Dandaria enters rage

Name: Nul
Origin: Tmavohmla predator adapted to black fog and near-constant twilight; valued by scouts for almost silent movement.
Movement: Silent sprint, wall-scramble, rooftop leap, shadow slip
Trait: Nearly soundless movement, muffles rider noise, sees in darkness, leaves faint or false tracks, perfect for ambush extraction
Weakness: Avoids loud battlefield chaos; weak against bright reveal-magic and wide-area fire

Name: Kintara
Origin: Granulian kirin line trained around crowded workshops, ropeways, and fast-moving machinery where precise balance matters more than brute speed.
Movement: Balance-run, wall-step burst, high leap, rapid sidestep
Trait: Kinetic redirection aura, exceptional balance, can intercept charges, reacts to rider’s body movement, protects limbs and flanks during close combat
Weakness: Requires disciplined rider control; performs poorly with reckless or panicked commands

Name: Deepbell
Origin: Skalodom tunnel-and-cliff breed used by miners to sense hollow stone and navigate layered fortifications and mountain paths.
Movement: Mountain climb, tunnel travel, narrow ledge walking, stone-step
Trait: Resonant horn call, morale-boosting rumble, remembers songs and routes, senses hollow stone and buried chambers, carries instruments and lore packs safely
Weakness: Slow on flat long-distance routes; stubborn unless guided by rhythm, song, or familiar rider cues

Name: Oculus
Origin: Juhieran coastal species nesting around cliffs and sea-cave approaches; scholars prize its exceptional long-range sight.
Movement: Flight, hover, perch, sharp dive, high-altitude scouting
Trait: Scry-linked vision, crystal eye crest, can relay battlefield angles to Alexander’s orb, excellent memory for observed fights, detects hidden movement patterns
Weakness: Vulnerable to anti-divination effects; becomes disoriented if its crystal sight is blinded or overloaded

Name: Grimhold
Origin: Heavy guard-courser line from the Chladohrad border roads, bred for snow travel, exposed approaches, and disciplined defensive work.
Movement: Rough terrain run, shield-brace stance, snow travel, controlled charge
Trait: Extremely reliable, does not panic, can brace beside Antikus like a living shield wall, strong endurance, carries spear-and-shield gear well
Weakness: Not flashy or especially fast; wins through patience and toughness, not special tricks

Name: Ruinmaw
Origin: Native to Ruiny Temnoty; one of the plane’s aggressive heavy predators and rarely tame enough to serve as a mount.
Movement: Rock climb, rubble crossing, brutal charge, short leap
Trait: Huge impact force, stone-like hide, excellent for monster impact, can carry a goliath comfortably, grows more aggressive when rider rages
Weakness: Poor long-distance speed; difficult to stop once committed to a charge

Name: Emberjoy
Origin: Juhieran forest-coast species strongly responsive to emotion, magical disturbance, and the behavior of nearby creatures.
Movement: Sprint, leap, glide, emotion-pulse tracking
Trait: Empathic bond, senses shifts in fear, anger, excitement, and monster behavior, reacts faster than commands, can flare colorful magic to distract or calm creatures
Weakness: Overreacts to strong emotions; can mirror Maja’s enthusiasm and become too eager

Name: Remedion
Origin: Sostrov healer’s mount line raised around the southern farms and wetland routes to carry herbs, antidotes, and wounded travelers.
Movement: Forest travel, careful mountain pathing, shallow water crossing, steady burden movement
Trait: Carries medical supplies, senses poison, disease, rot, and curse-taint, calming holy presence, can stabilize wounded riders, gentle but brave
Weakness: Avoids needless aggression; vulnerable if forced into direct frontline assault too long

Name: Vialtick
Origin: Granulian laboratory breed developed in alchemical workshops and mine labs to carry hazardous biological samples without contaminating handlers.
Movement: Wall crawl, tunnel crawl, marsh crossing, slow glide from height
Trait: Armored carapace, sample-storage chambers, toxin-resistant, can safely carry monster fluids, glands, spores, slime, and living reagents, field-lab saddle
Weakness: Not graceful and not fast; curious around dangerous biological material and may stop to investigate

Name: Gloamheart
Origin: Reed marshes between Jazierchat’s lakes and the AquaEvie shore; a local night-travel breed favored for quiet movement.
Movement: Shadow-step, silent stride, water-skimming
Trait: Sees through magical darkness, muffles movement, wraps rider in dim protective gloom
Weakness: Weakened by strong radiant light and hesitant on heavily consecrated ground

Name: Bastion
Origin: Dolinoraj valley breed preserved after the city’s fall; once used on old hunting roads and guard routes between the three mountains.
Movement: Sure-footed climb, burst charge, long-distance endurance
Trait: Highly disciplined, excellent tracker, steady under fear and missile fire
Weakness: Not stealthy and loses speed in deep swamp or unstable mud

Name: Saphros
Origin: Pieskostan predator from the northern stone-pillar desert and heat-scoured ridges beyond the city walls.
Movement: Great leaps, cliff climbing, short flame-dash bursts
Trait: Blue-fire mane, terrifying roar, heat resistance, brutal pounce attacks
Weakness: Temperamental when badly wounded and too conspicuous for subtle travel

Name: Refrén
Origin: Lesohaj species from the forested foothills and orchard slopes beneath the southwestern mountains, where its call carries between the trees.
Movement: Gliding jumps, cliff-leaping, agile hill running
Trait: Resonant call that boosts morale and disrupts foes, compact enough for a halfling, excellent balance
Weakness: Cannot carry heavy loads and struggles in prolonged direct melee against large beasts

Name: Boren
Origin: Jazierchat wetland species common in reed forests, marsh edges, and clan-held country around the city’s many lakes and AquaEvie.
Movement: Swimming, brush-walking, silent forest stride
Trait: Excellent scenting, natural camouflage, senses poison and corrupted flora, strong bond with druidic magic
Weakness: Uneasy in dense urban streets and less effective on barren stone or wasteland terrain

Name: Dawnshear
Origin: Chladohrad aerial hunter bred from cold-adapted griff stock found along frozen cliffs and expedition routes toward the southern pole.
Movement: Flight, snow-run, radiant dive, cliff launch
Trait: Radiant smite-channeling, cold resistance, fearless charge, excellent aerial pursuit, attacks threats before they reach protected allies
Weakness: Proud and difficult to hold back; poor choice for subtle missions or peaceful negotiations

Name: Graspwake
Origin: Ogramište arena stock later ritualized by Oker-family handlers; selected for autonomous defensive reflexes and brutal close-range mobility.
Movement: Sprint, leap, climb, sudden side-dash
Trait: Semi-independent tail and claw reflexes, can act to protect rider even when Amanda is stunned, reacts well to her autonomous arm, brutal close-combat mobility
Weakness: Requires constant control; may “help” before Amanda wants it to, especially when danger is close

Name: Auroveil
Origin: Jazierchat noble line associated with the Goldschmied estates; bred for dim-road travel and ceremonial display, with cursed-gold traits in rare bloodlines.
Movement: Shadow-gallop, mist-step, noble road endurance, short dark glide
Trait: Cursed-gold aura, dim-light camouflage, fear resistance, can turn shadow into brief golden flare, imposing noble presence
Weakness: Unstable around curse-breaking magic; its glamour weakens in plain daylight and consecrated places

Name: Ironmane
Origin: Ogramište arena stock where only animals that survive repeated monster bouts are kept for further breeding and war training.
Movement: Brutal charge, rough terrain push, mud crossing, shield-body advance
Trait: Heavy impact force, scarred antimagical hide, carries trophy gear, resists charm and fear, can body-block spells or monster charges
Weakness: Not a lion; slow to turn, poor at stealth, difficult to bond with because it only respects survival-tested riders

Name: Oddlight
Origin: Jazierchat species attracted to the academy, observatory, and enchanted-goods trade; collectors sometimes domesticate them as magical item-scouts.
Movement: Hover, glide, silent flutter, short arcane drift
Trait: Carries rare items safely, senses enchanted objects, creates soft distraction lights, excellent for caster repositioning, strangely charming to merchants and collectors
Weakness: Fragile in direct combat; drawn toward magical curiosities and may become distracted by rare artifacts

Name: Gromveil
Origin: Granulian warhorse line trained on outer rail roads and blast-scorched testing grounds, making it unusually calm around gunfire, thunder, and explosions.
Movement: Gallop, burst charge, strong footing on roads and broken ground
Trait: Looks like a normal disciplined warhorse outside combat; battle state ignites eerie green flame; fearless under gunfire, thunder, and panic; accelerates brutally fast for sudden engagement
Weakness: Ghostfire gives away position once combat starts; less effective in deep swamp, dense forest, or prolonged stealth travel

Name: Rimeguard
Origin: Chladohrad species nesting on frozen escarpments and wind shelves outside the city and along polar expedition routes.
Movement: Flight, glide, cliff landing, cold-weather ascent
Trait: Powerful wings, excellent cold endurance, calm protector temperament, dependable with rider and gear, steady in mountain winds
Weakness: Heavy appetite; heat and humid lowlands reduce stamina; less agile in tight urban spaces

Name: Vesperian
Origin: Juhieran night-forest predator found between the coast, mountain approaches, and the woodland road toward Lesohaj.
Movement: Silent sprint, climb, leap, rooftop and wall-edge movement
Trait: Smarter than most give it credit for, responds to tiny cues, elegant and quiet, excellent stalker, unnerves lesser beasts without flashy aggression
Weakness: Not a brute line-breaker; dislikes exposed open terrain and long heavy hauling; weaker in prolonged frontal clashes

Name: Judicar
Origin: Chladohrad heavy-beast line used on fortified pilgrimage and expedition routes around the Aurora Serpent shrine, where cold endurance and mass matter more than speed.
Movement: Charge, snow-trudge, rubble push, defensive bracing
Trait: Armor-like hide, tremendous stopping power, naturally protective, ideal for holding lines and breaking monster formations, unwavering under pressure
Weakness: Large turning radius; poor in dense forest and narrow streets; too heavy for fragile bridges or subtle travel

Name: Myrrok
Origin: Sostrov wetland predator from flooded brush and shallow channels between the southern islands, able to cross water with barely a ripple.
Movement: Swim, climb, long leap, trunk-running, brush-slipping
Trait: Almost impossibly graceful movement, near-silent hunting, crosses rivers with barely a ripple, disappears through vegetation, makes rider seem supernatural without any flashy magic
Weakness: Not made for armored burden or siege-style clashes; dry open plains expose it more; relies on movement rather than heavy durability
